title: Preset-relative VIXEN build path is ambiguous from the VIXEN source directory
body: The queued build failed because cmake --preset vixen-wsl writes to ../build/wsl, while the natural follow-up cmake --build build/wsl from VIXEN resolves to VIXEN/build/wsl. The preset or helper should expose/validate the generated binaryDir so the supported build command cannot target a nonexistent path.

title: Focused VIXEN verification target omits declared application CPU tests
body: The queued rendergraph_svo_tests build left Application.LookdevClosure.Manifest, Application.UpscalerSelection, and Application.AntiAliasingSelection as NOT_BUILT, so acceptance required a second queued build of test_closure_manifest, test_upscaler_selection, and test_aa_selection. The aggregate verification target should include all non-GPU correctness executables or expose a documented target that does. Tier luna: this is a normal target-coverage consolidation across the application test registration. Effort S: a target dependency or documented aggregate mapping should close it.

title: VIXEN focused verification starts without a warm target artifact
body: The resumed lane had to perform a cold queued build of rendergraph_svo_tests before any focused witness could run; no published warm target or prewarm step was available for this worktree. The landing/prewarm flow should publish or restore the focused VIXEN verification artifacts keyed to the merged tip. Tier luna: this needs normal cache/published-artifact integration. Effort S: expose the existing warm build or fail early with the exact prewarm command.
